hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.
Attached to the Implementation Profile https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/raster-rendering (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-rendering, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

processDescription.inherited.json added with the attachment to the Implementation Profile raster-rendering: the deployed processDescription with each bound input and output linked to the role it implements (metadata, role implementation-input or implementation-output) and carrying that role's dataType; the profile schema inherits it. The deployed processDescription is unchanged.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/algae-bloom/plot-image to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/algae-bloom/plot-image, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/algae-bloom/plot-image/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

processDescription: in processDescription.inherited.json, each input and output that has a data type now names its representations (representation), the df:Representation items of bblocks-data-formats that realize that data type in a format the deployment declares (decision of 2026-11-18); the inputs/outputs of the deployment's own output output_file get a dataType (profiles.yaml data_types). Classified substantive: the form in which a part of the entry is stated changes.

definition: Applies the specified color mapping with scaled bins to a geospatial image.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Partial: the export part (GeoTIFF + PNG) corresponds to save_result with a GTiff or PNG format; `clip_min`/`clip_max` correspond to math.clip. The colour mapping (`color_scale` bins) and the matplotlib figure (title, colour bar) have no stable openEO process (colour maps are back-end-specific format options).
